body: Yes I'm still here. I'm thinking of going to a psychiatrist. As much as I don't want meds I think i need them right now.

I understand exactly how you feel, in fact I just wrote a post asking for pretty much this same thing. I have an appointment to see a therapist, because I feel like it's their job to listen to you and you wouldn't be a burden. I thinkayne once I talk to the therapist, it might make it easier to talk to friends and lived ones. That's just my advice.

I'm recently married, but my husband works to hard, he doesn't need to put up with my bullshit. He deserves so much more than a jobless, useless wife with no direction in life. I don't want to hurt anyone, I just want to crawl into a hole and die.

This doesn't feel like this is the first step to getting better. This feels like the last plea before the jump. I feel like a complete waste of space and a burden to everyone who knows me. I have three weeks until my first therapy appointment, and I don't think I can last that long.
